Fig. 8: Progressive replacement results using FARE robust modules. Adversarial robustness against AutoAttack (ϵ = 4/255, APGD) is plotted as standard CLIP modules are cumulatively replaced by FARE’s corresponding components across four datasets: Caltech101, CIFAR100, STL10, and CIFAR10. The results consistently validate that robustness is largely established within the initial stages (Emb. and B1-Attn).
